description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Front Leaf Springs Seats/Plate.
These are used to Attach the Front Leaf Springs to the Front Axle.
LH & RH Sides Included!
Made by SUZUKI
Stabilizer mounts are on the outside of the plates for wider stabilizer bar
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – LH Front – Leaf Spring Plate
Qty 1 – RH Front – Leaf Spring Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1990 – 1995 All Models
